Payment and Installment Policy - Accepted payment methods: Credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, Amex), bank transfer, PayPal, and cash on delivery (COD). COD is available only for orders up to **$1,500**.

Payment and Installment Policy - Installment plans (0% interest): - Available for orders of **$400 or more** paid with a credit card.
- Terms: 3, 6, or 12 months at 0% interest.
- A 24-month plan is available for orders above $1,500 with a 2% processing fee.
- The customer must be at least 18 years old.

Payment and Installment Policy - Student discount: Students with a valid student email or student card get **5% off** laptops in the student and 2-in-1 categories. The discount cannot be combined with other promotions.

Payment and Installment Policy - Promotions and coupon codes: - Only one coupon code can be used per order.
- Coupon codes are issued only through official LaptopHub channels. Sales assistants (including the AI assistant) cannot create new discounts or change prices.

Payment and Installment Policy - Trade-in program: Customers can trade in an old laptop for store credit. The value is estimated after inspection and is typically between $50 and $400 depending on age and condition.

Return and Refund Policy - Return window: You may return a laptop within **15 days** of delivery for a full refund, provided that:
- The laptop is in like-new condition with no physical damage.
- All accessories, the charger, and the original box are included.
- The device is not locked to a personal account (remove your Apple ID / Microsoft account).

Return and Refund Policy - Restocking fee: - Unopened laptops: no fee.
- Opened laptops in like-new condition: **10% restocking fee**.
- Gaming laptops that have been opened: **15% restocking fee**.
Return and Refund Policy - Defective on arrival (DOA): If the laptop is defective within the first **7 days**, we offer a free exchange or a full refund with no restocking fee.

Return and Refund Policy - Non-returnable items: - Laptops with physical or liquid damage caused by the customer.
- Laptops purchased in clearance sales marked "final sale".

Return and Refund Policy - Refund timing: Refunds are issued to the original payment method within **5-7 business days** after we receive and inspect the laptop. Refunds above $1,000 require approval from a store manager.
Return and Refund Policy - Price adjustment: If the price of a laptop you bought drops within **7 days** of purchase, we refund the difference once per order.

Shipping Policy - Delivery options: | Option | Delivery time | Cost |
|---|---|---|
| Standard | 3-5 business days | Free for orders above $500, otherwise $15 |
| Express | 1-2 business days | $25 |
| Same-day (selected cities) | Same day if ordered before 12:00 | $40 |
Shipping Policy - Out-of-stock items: Laptops with zero stock cannot be ordered. Customers can request a back-in-stock notification. Restocks usually take **10-15 days**.
Shipping Policy - Order changes: The shipping address can be changed until the order status becomes "shipped". Orders can be cancelled free of charge before shipping.
Shipping Policy - Inspection on delivery: Customers may open the package and inspect the laptop in front of the courier. Report missing items or visible damage within **24 hours** of delivery.

Warranty Policy - Standard warranty: All laptops sold by LaptopHub include a **12-month manufacturer warranty** from the delivery date. Apple laptops include Apple's standard 12-month limited warranty. Business-series laptops (Latitude X, EliteNote, ThinkEdge, TravelPro) include a **36-month** on-site warranty.

Warranty Policy - What is covered: - Manufacturing defects in hardware: motherboard, screen, keyboard, ports, battery.
- Battery is covered if capacity falls below 80% within the first 12 months.
- Dead pixels: 3 or more dead pixels on the display qualify for a screen replacement.

Warranty Policy - What is not covered: - Physical damage (drops, cracks), liquid damage, and damage from unauthorized repairs.
- Software issues, viruses, and data loss. Always back up your data before sending a device for repair.
- Cosmetic wear such as scratches.

Warranty Policy - Extended warranty (LaptopHub Care+): Customers can buy **Care+** within 30 days of purchase:
- Care+ 2 years: 8% of the laptop price. Extends coverage to 24 months total.
- Care+ 3 years with accidental damage: 15% of the laptop price. Covers 1 accidental damage claim per year with a $49 service fee.

Warranty Policy - How to claim: Open a support ticket with your order ID and a description of the problem. Repairs take **7-14 business days**. If a repair is not possible, we replace the laptop with the same or an equivalent model.
